title: Norm of the Uniform Vector
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$, let $u\in\mathbb{R}^n$ be the constant vector whose coordinates are $1/n$. Then $\langle u,u\rangle=1/n$.
hypotheses_covered: $u$ is the constant vector with coordinates $1/n$
